text:
Nadia Gomez: FYI GCP marketplace requested our security evidence pack for the upcoming listing review. They want SOC2 PDF, pen-test executive summary (redacted), ISO cert snapshot if available, and an HSM/KMS diagram by next Friday. Reviewer: gcp-marketplace@google.example.com
Tom Reed: Can we confirm whether GCP accepts presigned links or requires upload to their portal? I remember a previous flow was portal-only.
Priya Kapoor: I asked the GCP contact: they accept presigned URLs for artifacts <= 200MB, otherwise portal upload. I'll paste their verbatim: "We prefer portal uploads but presigned S3/GS links are acceptable for transient review. Please include a manifest describing redactions."
Liam O'Connor: Good to know. For HSM details we should avoid sharing key material; provide an architecture diagram that shows KMS/HSM boundaries and an ops contact. Olivia, can you sketch the diagram?
Olivia Chen: I can. Will create two versions: public diagram (no hostnames, no key IDs) and an annotated private diagram for reviewer only with sensitive bits obfuscated. Both PDFs.
Nadia Gomez: Also GCP asked for the pen-test vendor contact and scope. We used SecureOps last engagement — link to contract: https://vault.internal/contracts/secureops-2024 (internal).
Priya Kapoor: Note: SecureOps full report contains raw logs. We must not share logs or pcap. Proposed deliverables: exec summary (redacted), redaction-manifest.txt (one-line items), and full report only via presigned link with approved redactions.
Tom Reed: Ops will create GCS bucket gcp-marketplace-evidence/req-5221/. I'll generate signed URLs with 7-day expiry. If they need longer, we can re-issue.
compliance-bot: Auto-check: most recent SOC2 Type II (2024-11-02) on file. ISO 27001 snapshot not in vault  will ping compliance owner.
Priya Kapoor: Owners proposal: SOC2 pull (Nadia), Pen-test redaction (Liam + SecureOps), Diagrams (Olivia), Uploads (Tom), Legal attestation (legal-notify). I'll coordinate and submit to GCP.
Liam O'Connor: Quick redaction rules I'm using: replace internal hostnames with REDACTED-HOST-# , strip IP addresses, remove employee PII, remove raw capture attachments. Manifest will list the original filenames and redact reasons.
Olivia Chen: Also tagging SI partner leads. For SI integrations we should include the integration data-flow doc (sanitized) so reviewers understand how data flows to partner services. Any objections?
Nadia Gomez: No objections. Make sure we include a one-paragraph note on data residency and retention for marketplace reviewers. GCP asked about EU data residency options.
Tom Reed: Upload steps (GCS):
```
# create folder
gsutil mb -p redwood-prod gs://gcp-marketplace-evidence
gsutil cp ./SOC2_2024.pdf gs://gcp-marketplace-evidence/req-5221/soc2/SOC2_2024.pdf
# generate signed URL
gsutil signurl -d 7d /path/to/service-account.json gs://gcp-marketplace-evidence/req-5221/soc2/SOC2_2024.pdf
```
legal-notify: Please prepare the attestation PDF stating redactions preserve technical meaning and that no cryptographic secrets are disclosed. Signature required from Head of Legal.
compliance-bot: Created ticket COMP-7789 for evidence bundle review. Checklist: SOC2 present, pen-test redacted + manifest, HSM/KMS diagram obfuscated, SI data-flow sanitized. Assignee: Priya Kapoor.
Priya Kapoor: Timeline suggestion: initial drafts by Wed EOD, security review Thu midday, upload Fri morning to meet the Friday review window. Is that feasible?
Liam O'Connor: I can have the redacted pen-test exec summary + manifest by Wed noon. SecureOps is ok with redaction.
Olivia Chen: Diagrams ready Wed EOD. Will include a short caption explaining what's redacted.
Tom Reed: I'll provision the GCS prefix today and post signed URL examples once artifacts are live.
Nadia Gomez: I'll fetch SOC2 and ISO artifacts from vault and hand them to Priya by Tue end.
Priya Kapoor: Great. I'll run the bundle through COMP-7789 checklist and ping legal for final attestation. If anyone hits blockers, escalate here and we'll do a 15-min sync.
partners-bot: Reminder: marketplace evidence retention policy is 60 days for GCP pre-listing artifacts. :calendar:
Tom Reed: Note for reviewers: if they need the raw full report for their adjudicators, we'll provide access under NDA and time-limited presigns; raw logs will never be shared.
Nadia Gomez: Final owners recap: Nadia (SOC2/ISO pull), Liam (pen-test redaction), Olivia (diagrams), Tom (uploads/presigns), Priya (coordinator + submit), Legal (attestation). Meeting if needed Wed 10:00 PT.
Priya Kapoor: Thanks team — I'll post progress updates here.
